rows.text: Armed Archaeologists are truly the oddballs of the Intelligentsia Guild. Many scholars in this faction are obsessed with combining weaponry and excavation tools, just so they can come in handy at critical moments. 15 Amber Eras ago, an archaeological team from the Sandridge-III Observation Station landed on a planet's surface, intending to study the remains of a Swarm King stranded there. However, a swarm of True Stings buried deep underground suddenly revived during the sampling process. The team suffered heavy casualties, leaving only their leader, Slay, alive. He held out alone on the planet for 5 years, continuing the excavation while fighting off the incoming Swarm with his armed archaeological shovel. Yet, when the IPC fleet arrived for the rescue, Slay resisted violently, eventually choosing to end his own life due to the "unshakable buzzing" in his head.
